facts.fact: ATDI chairman Adilson Gomes said on 12 May 2026 that an integrated registration process involving the Justice sector and the national civil identification directorate (DNIC) is being worked on, with a single app to register and integrate citizen information still to come.

MOZ.note: Digitalising civil registration is called a government priority; no system procured, piloted or rolled out is stated.
No online service or portal described.
Only an intent to collect biometric data in an integrated registration; no national ID system described.
